1. Introduction
This document constitutes MODULE 1 — ADMINISTRATIVE INFORMATION of the Common Technical Document (CTD) format as specified in ICH M4 guidelines for the biologics license application (BLA) of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) submitted by Moderna, Inc. to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The submission follows the eCTD format as required by 21 CFR Part 314 and FDA guidance on eCTD submissions.
Appendix — Document Index
Full document list available in the eCTD backbone. All documents submitted per FDA eCTD guidance (M8) and organized using the Moderna, Inc. submission management system.
